verdict.rationale: Paperspace documents a public RESTful API for managing resources over HTTP, authenticated with team-scoped API keys. A machine-readable OpenAPI 3.0.3 spec (61 paths) is served at api.paperspace.com/v1, and a generated per-endpoint reference with cURL examples is built from it; the 404s from the probe hit docs-domain paths, not the versioned API artifact, so they do not contradict this. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the API works end-to-end for agent-driven workflows.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: Programmatically manage Paperspace resources using conventional HTTP requests.
API keys let you interact with Paperspace through the Core RESTful API, the Core JavaScript SDK, and Gradient command-line utility (CLI). API Keys have team-scoped permissions
The production API domain serves a machine-readable OpenAPI 3.0.3 document at /v1/openapi.json (info title "Paperspace OpenAPI", version "1", 61 paths; servers https://api.paperspace.com/v1).
